past.title: NK Cruisers Cruise In | Aug 21st
past.body:
[1st & 3rd fri] NK Cruisers Cruise In

Friday, August 21st | 6-9p

Located at Rosie's Lot 7, 10515 Colonial Downs Pkwy., New Kent.

NK Cruisers meet the 1st and 3rd Friday 6-9p or until the last person leaves (November-March). NK Cruisers, a local car enthusiast and cruise-in group bringing the car community together between Richmond and Williamsburg. The focus is New Kent, Charles City, and Lanexa but we welcome all folks from all areas. All years, makes, models, years, cars, truck, motorcycles, golf carts, boats, tractors, and trailered vehicles always welcome. Inclement weather cancels. For more information email: nkcruisers@gmail.com and NK Cruisers Facebook page for announcements and information. www.facebook.com/groups/277456353510653/

past.title: Classic Cruisers Saturday Night Cruz In | Aug 15th
past.body:
(Weekly) Classic Cruisers Saturday Night Cruz In Presented by Classic Cruisers Car Club

Saturday, August 15th | 4:30-8p

Located at Coastal Community Church, 101 Village Ave., Yorktown.

Mark your calendar to join us for our 1st Cruise-In. Cruz-Ins will be every Saturday from Apr 25 to Oct 24.

All years and types of vehicles are welcome – If you believe it’s cool, bring it in. We are asking for a $2.00 donation per vehicle. Please consider donating more – All proceeds go to charity. Vehicles are to be parked as directed by club personnel when necessary. No bicycles, skateboards, scooters, roller blades, or anything used in a manner that could injure people or damage vehicles are allowed in the participant parking area. Please do not touch vehicles without owners’ permission. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult. No horseplay is allowed with vehicles at any time. (Such as burn-outs, engine revving, car hopping, loud radios or other disruptive actions). Alcoholic beverages, illegal drugs, and firearms are prohibited. There are to be NO SALES within the participant parking area EXCEPT for pre-approved items where the sale benefits charity. We are guests here. So PLEASE either take your trash with you or use the receptacles provided. 

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: MCT presents Summer Sizzle Car Show | Aug 8th
past.body:
MCT presents Summer Sizzle Car Show

Saturday, August 8th | 9a-2p

Located at Cavalier Ford | 4021 Portsmouth Boulevard, Chesapeake VA 23321

This show is hosted by Cavalier Ford Chesapeake Square, a sponsor of the Mustang Club of Tidewater, and held in support of Trails of Purpose equine-assisted therapies and mental health counseling. The MCT happily welcomes all years, makes and models of passenger cars, trucks, and motorcycles to participate in this show.

This is a family friendly event, so feel free to bring the kids (or parents) so they can enjoy the show!!

Registration will be onsite only. There is no charge for spectators, who will be directed to parking adjacent to the show vehicle parking area.

Please only park in the designated areas for show and spectator parking, as directed by parking staff. There will be people who will post that they are taking online registrations.

They are scammers and not in any way authorized to do online registrations. DO NOT register with anyone online, as we will only do registration and accept payments (check/cash) at the show site.

This is a Judged Classes show, with multiple Class awards, and 4 top awards for Best in Show, Dealer’s Choice, VFW Choice, and Club Participation. There will also be a 50/50 drawing at the conclusion of the show.

Schedule: 9:00A | Registration Opens.

Clubs wishing to park together should arrive together to facilitate easier parking. Parking will be as directed by show staff. All entrant vehicles parked in the show vehicle area must pay the registration fee. Please do not arrive prior to 8:30 a.m. to allow for vendor and lot setup to occur.

10:00A | Driver's Meeting / Judging Begins. This is a Judged Classes show.

12:00P | Registration Closed. No further judged entries after this time.

1:00P | Judging Ends

1:30P | Car Show Awards Presented and 50/50 Drawing held. Good Luck!!

2:00P | Show Complete. Please exit safely and have a great day!!

The show schedule is subject to modification should the weather dictate we change it.

We are actively looking for Vendors to advertise and/or sell their products/services at this show. Vendor spaces are available for $25.00 + two (or more) cans/boxes of non-perishable food for donation. This allows you space for a 10x10 shelter and table setup, adjacent to the show vehicle parking area.

If you need additional space, please let us know. Email mustangcluboftidewater67@yahoo.com for more information. Trails of Purpose (https://www.trailsofpurpose.com) will also be attending, providing information on the services they offer to support service members and their families in their fight to overcome the negative effects of trauma, transition, and trials that result from their service in the military. Please visit them at the show!

Event Contact: Michael Marushia, President, MCT. 757-969-2038, MustangPilot55@gmail.com

past.title: Cars and Coffee Chesapeake | Aug 8th
past.body:
[2nd sat] Cars and Coffee Chesapeake

Saturday, August 8th | 8a-11a

Located at Everbowl - 1244 Greenbrier Pkwy #570, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Team Ultraspeed and Everbowl are teaming up to bring you the best Cars and Coffee meets in the area! Come hangout and help us close out the 2025 Car Season. We are collecting non-perishable goods this month for the Foodbank of Southwestern VA. Give Thanks, Give Food. Help us drive out hunger! We are also still collecting new kids pajamas to support Pajama Jams. Pajama Jams collects these items throughout the year in preparation for their important Annual Holiday Pajama Drive for Hampton Roads. Please drop off your donations at the Red Ultraspeed tent, you can write it off on your taxes! We are now a 501(C)3! You won't want to miss this, so mark your calendars and we'll see you there! 

More info
